retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait featuring a central figure in textured outerwear with elegant script typography flanking the head.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white album cover
excludeWhen: minimalist sans-serif typography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast monochrome composition centered on a male figure wearing a dark, textured leather jacket over a white shirt. The background is pure white, creating a silhouette effect. Elegant, slanted script typography is positioned symmetrically on either side of the subject's head.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the dark jacket and the pure white background
Symmetrical placement of script text relative to the central head
Texture of the leather jacket contrasting with the smooth skin tones
Vertical alignment of the subject's torso anchoring the frame
coreInvariants: High-key lighting on the face and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium-close shot from the waist up, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and intense gaze at the top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the clenched hands/watch, then outward to the script text on the sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Pure white negative space at the top corners and behind the head to isolate the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows and jacket texture
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in skin and metallic details
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from 0% to 100% brightness.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders and ascenders to fill horizontal space

composition.position: Flanking the head at eye level

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script face used for all text elements to maintain elegance.
graphicDevices: Rectangular advisory label in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-contrast calligraphic style.
Provides the necessary ornate flourishes and slant.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a textured leather jacket against a pure white background, centered and looking at the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add formal script text in a light gray color with a subtle drop shadow, positioned symmetrically on the left and right sides of the subject's head.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without artifacts?
Is the script text legible and elegantly slanted?

mustAchieve: Distinct separation between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Verify script text is not touching the subject's head
Confirm high-detail texture in the clothing
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + pure white background + symmetrical formal script overlay.
